body: READ-ONLY BLOCKER at 5ab3a0a: chief's ratified law says ReceiptKeyMismatch => fresh receipt under K with calls preserved, FOREIGN BODY DROPPED. contract.scala:1046-1050 passes the untrusted result.receipt.cacheDecisions and policyDecisions into rejectProviderResult; :673-680 then copies them into the new trusted receipt. A delegate can therefore inject arbitrary cache/policy audit facts under the wrapper's key. ContractSuite's foreign-key test (:260-307) only asserts calls preserved and embeddingReceipts empty; it never makes/asserts nonempty foreign cache/policy. Please pass empty cache/policy on conforming rejection and add canary foreign decisions proving both are absent. Parallel cache path also concatenates wrapper decisions with fresh.receipt cache/policy (:155-156), then preserves the concatenation on receipt failure (:181-210); keep only wrapper-owned decisions/denials there and add the same probe.
